name: Yosemite Valley & High Country
agency: NPS Yosemite GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Granite monoliths, thundering waterfalls, and high-country rim loops from Happy Isles to Glacier Point and Half Dome.

trails.name: Mist Trail to Vernal & Nevada Falls
trails.condition_note: Granite steps wet from waterfall spray; potable water seasonal at Vernal footbridge.
trails.description: Yosemite's signature waterfall trail climbing over 600 granite steps alongside Vernal Fall (317 ft) and Nevada Fall (594 ft).

trails.name: John Muir Trail (Clark Point Return to Happy Isles)
trails.condition_note: Clear and dry; ideal knee-friendly descent forming a loop with the Mist Trail.
trails.description: Scenic switchback corridor via Clark Point with panoramic views of Liberty Cap and the back of Half Dome.

trails.name: Vernal & Nevada Falls Loop via Mist Trail & JMT
trails.condition_note: Ascend Mist Trail, descend JMT for optimal footing.
trails.description: Complete loop ascending the dramatic granite staircase of the Mist Trail and returning via the panoramic John Muir Trail.

trails.name: Half Dome Summit Extension (from Nevada Fall)
trails.condition_note: Day-use permit required for Sub Dome & cables; never ascend if thunderclouds form.
trails.description: Climbs through Little Yosemite Valley and up Sub Dome to the famous Half Dome cable route at 8,842 ft.

trails.name: Panorama Trail & Four Mile Trail Loop
trails.condition_note: Continuous Yosemite Falls, Half Dome, and Illilouette Fall views.
trails.description: Grand Yosemite Valley rim loop connecting Happy Isles, Nevada Fall, Illilouette Ridge, Glacier Point, and the Four Mile Trail.
